corrections.text: The article quotes Microsoft AI's announcement as reporting a "22% improvement on Terminal-Bench 2.1 for GitHub Copilot CLI." Microsoft AI's actual wording is "a 22% improvement on Terminal-Bench 2.1 in GitHub Copilot CLI" — the article substituted "for" for "in" inside the quotation marks. The 22% figure itself is accurate.

The article quotes Microsoft AI's announcement as reporting a "4% rise in code survival rates" and a "9% increase in return visits." Microsoft AI's actual wording is "code survival rose 4%" and "return visits increased 9%" — the article reworded these into different phrasing while presenting them in quotation marks as verbatim. The 4% and 9% figures themselves are accurate.
